id: 01_1. Nature and Basic Properties of Light
title: 光的本质与基本性质
source_doc: course/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/01_1. Nature and Basic Properties of Light.md
author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/01_1. Nature and Basic Properties of Light/src.py

points.K4: 光是电磁能，有两副面孔
points.K5: 像波的时候：传播、折射、反射
points.K6: 像粒子的时候：吸收与发射
points.K12: 光在空间和时间里传递能量
points.K20: 折射率：光进介质会变慢

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学实验室门口，身后一道彩虹光带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of an optics lab with a soft rainbow band of light behind it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课从头说起：光到底是什么？
overlay: 光是什么：光的本质与基本性质

shots.scene: 波浪、小光球、彩虹光谱、玻璃块四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a wavy line, a small glowing ball, a rainbow spectrum bar, and a clear glass block. No people.
shots.narration: 波、粒子、光谱、折射率，一一认识。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进光学实验室，好奇地凑近一台盖着罩子的激光器
shots.prompt_en: On his first day in an optics lab, the young male student leans curiously toward a covered laser on an optical table.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进光学实验室，满眼好奇。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着光学平台上的镜片和光路，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at mirrors and lenses on an optical table and scratches his head in confusion.
shots.narration: 他问：这些光到底是什么东西？

shots.scene: 小研笑着翻开空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and opens a blank notebook on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：先学会描述光的语言。

shots.scene: 老周递给阿杰一本空白的入门手册
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the young male student a blank introductory handbook with a light bulb icon on the cover.
shots.narration: 老周说：今天先上第一课，认识光。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 跟着欣欣，从光的本质学起。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一排八本编号的空白书脊，第一本发光
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of eight blank book spines; the first one glows softly.
shots.narration: 这是光学入门的第一课。

shots.scene: 五个目标图标依次点亮：尺子、时钟、双面硬币、彩虹条、玻璃块
shots.prompt_en: Five goal icons light up one by one: a ruler, a clock, a two-sided coin, a rainbow bar, and a glass block. No people.
shots.narration: 波长频率、二象性、光谱和折射率。

shots.scene: 一束光从灯里出来，经过镜子、光纤，进入探测器，最后点亮屏幕
shots.prompt_en: A beam of light leaves a lamp, bounces off a mirror, runs through a fiber cable into a detector, and lights a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 光子学：产生、操控、传输光。

shots.scene: 光束继续延伸，末端探测器把光变成信号
shots.prompt_en: The beam ends at a small detector that turns the light into a pulsing signal icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还要探测光，并把光能用起来。

shots.scene: 一颗发光的种子长出多根枝条，枝头是通信、医疗、制造图标
shots.prompt_en: A glowing seed sprouts branches tipped with icons for communication, medicine, and manufacturing. No people.
shots.narration: 它能带动很多领域发展，叫使能技术。

shots.scene: 超市收银台扫码器发出红光扫过空白条码
shots.prompt_en: At a supermarket checkout, a scanner sweeps a thin red line across a blank barcode.
shots.narration: 超市扫码，用的是激光。

shots.scene: 光盘播放机、激光打印机、数码相机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a disc player, a laser printer, and a digital camera. No people.
shots.narration: 光盘、打印机、相机，都靠光工作。

shots.scene: 细细的光纤穿过城市，连着电脑和电话
shots.prompt_en: Thin glowing fiber cables run under a city, linking computers and telephones. No people.
shots.narration: 光纤把海量信息送往四面八方。

shots.scene: 医院里的成像屏幕和眼科手术台图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hospital imaging screen and an eye surgery chair. No people.
shots.narration: 医院成像、激光眼科手术也离不开光。

shots.scene: 军用雷达车与激光装置图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a military vehicle with a radar dish and a large laser device on a stand. No people.
shots.narration: 军事上也在用激光。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在阳光下张开双臂
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in warm sunlight with arms wide open.
shots.narration: 从出生那天起，我们就活在光里。

shots.section_title: 光是电磁能，有两副面孔
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一枚硬币，一面是波浪图标，一面是小光球图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large coin with a wavy line icon on one side and a small glowing ball icon on the other.
shots.narration: 光是一种电磁能，有两副面孔。
overlay: 光是电磁能，有两副面孔

shots.section_title: 光是电磁能，有两副面孔
shots.scene: 硬币翻转，两面交替出现
shots.prompt_en: The large coin flips slowly in the air, showing the wave side and then the particle side. No people.
shots.narration: 有时像波，有时像粒子，叫二象性。

shots.section_title: 像波的时候：传播、折射、反射
shots.scene: 光像水波一样穿过窄缝，向外扩展
shots.prompt_en: Light ripples like water waves through a narrow slit and spreads out on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 光穿过小孔时，表现得像波。
overlay: 像波的时候：传播、折射、反射

shots.section_title: 像波的时候：传播、折射、反射
shots.scene: 一束光射入水中拐了个弯，另一束光在镜面弹回
shots.prompt_en: One light beam bends as it enters water; another bounces back from a flat mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 进入另一种介质会拐弯，遇镜面会反射。

shots.section_title: 像波的时候：传播、折射、反射
shots.scene: 两组小箭头一起起伏，向前推进
shots.prompt_en: Two sets of small arrows rise and fall together as they move forward like a rope wave. No people.
shots.narration: 这时的光，是一起振动的电场和磁场。

shots.section_title: 像粒子的时候：吸收与发射
shots.scene: 黑色布料吸收一颗颗小光球，微微发热
shots.prompt_en: A dark cloth absorbs a stream of small glowing balls and gives off a faint warm glow. No people.
shots.narration: 被材料吸收时，光像一份份能量。
overlay: 像粒子的时候：吸收与发射

shots.section_title: 像粒子的时候：吸收与发射
shots.scene: 一盏灯泡向外弹出一颗颗小光球
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb pops out small glowing balls one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 物质发光时，也是一份份放出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在九张空白卡片前，卡片排成三行
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of nine blank cards arranged in three rows.
shots.narration: 描述光，要先学会九个词。

shots.scene: 九张卡片中剩下四张翻开，出现图标
shots.prompt_en: Four more blank cards flip over to show simple icons: two overlapping waves, a lined-up marching row, a vertical slit filter, and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 还有相位、相干性、偏振和能量。

shots.scene: 小研对阿杰点头，阿杰在空白笔记本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nods at the young male student, who writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 这些词，是光学技术员的基本功。

shots.scene: 海面上一排排浪，有浪峰有浪谷
shots.prompt_en: Rows of ocean waves with clear crests and troughs roll across the sea. No people.
shots.narration: 海浪有高有低，沿着海面一排排分布。

shots.scene: 一只停泊的小船随浪上下起伏
shots.prompt_en: A small anchored boat bobs up and down as waves pass under it. No people.
shots.narration: 停着的小船，随时间一上一下。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比划：一手画波浪，一手指时钟
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot traces a wave in the air with one paw and points at a wall clock with the other.
shots.narration: 在空间和时间里都重复，才叫波。

shots.scene: 水波、声波、光波三个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a water wave, sound rings from a speaker, and a light wave from a lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 水振动是水波，空气振动是声波。

shots.scene: 光波图标放大，里面两组小箭头在振动
shots.prompt_en: The light wave icon zooms in to show two sets of tiny arrows vibrating. No people.
shots.narration: 电场和磁场振动，就是光。

shots.scene: 一根跳绳抖出波形，中间有一条水平虚线
shots.prompt_en: A jump rope is shaken into a wave shape above a horizontal dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 离开中线多远，叫位移。

shots.scene: 最高的浪峰处亮起一个高度箭头
shots.prompt_en: A height arrow lights up from the dashed line to the highest crest of the rope wave. No people.
shots.narration: 最大的位移，叫振幅。

shots.scene: 两个相邻浪峰之间出现一把尺子
shots.prompt_en: A ruler appears between two neighboring crests of the rope wave. No people.
shots.narration: 相邻两个波峰的距离，叫波长。

shots.scene: 尺子缩小，变成很小的刻度
shots.prompt_en: The ruler shrinks down to a tiny scale with very fine tick marks. No people.
shots.narration: 波长用长度单位，光常用纳米。

shots.scene: 海边灯塔旁，一个浪峰拍岸，计时器开始走
shots.prompt_en: A wave crest hits the shore next to a lighthouse while a stopwatch starts. No people.
shots.narration: 下一个浪峰再来，用了多少时间？

shots.scene: 计时器停下，显示一个圆圈图标
shots.prompt_en: The stopwatch stops when the next crest arrives, and a full circle icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 重复一次所用的时间，叫周期。

shots.scene: 一秒钟里浪峰一个接一个拍岸，计数器跳动
shots.prompt_en: In one second, crests hit the shore one after another while a counter ticks up. No people.
shots.narration: 一秒钟重复多少次，叫频率。

shots.scene: 一道光像跑车一样在真空跑道上飞驰
shots.prompt_en: A beam of light races down an empty track in dark space like a sports car. No people.
shots.narration: 在真空里，光速是一个固定的常数。

shots.scene: 长步和短步两个小人图标沿同一条跑道前进
shots.prompt_en: Two walking icons on the same track: one takes long slow steps, the other takes short quick steps. No people.
shots.narration: 步子乘每秒步数，就是行进速度。

shots.scene: 波浪图标替换小人，长波慢摆、短波快摆
shots.prompt_en: Wave icons replace the walkers: a long wave swings slowly, a short wave swings quickly, both moving at the same speed. No people.
shots.narration: 光速一定，波长越短，频率越高。

shots.scene: 一个关系式方框，三个图标：跑道、尺子、计数器
shots.prompt_en: A framed box with three icons in a row: a racing track, a ruler, and a counter. No people.
shots.narration: 光速等于波长乘以频率。

shots.section_title: 光在空间和时间里传递能量
shots.scene: 上下两条波：上面沿距离分布，下面沿时间变化
shots.prompt_en: Two stacked wave strips: the top one spreads along a distance ruler, the bottom one changes along a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 光是空间和时间里的扰动。
overlay: 光在空间和时间里传递能量

shots.section_title: 光在空间和时间里传递能量
shots.scene: 波把一颗能量小球从左送到右
shots.prompt_en: A wave carries a small glowing energy ball from the left side to the right side. No people.
shots.narration: 它把能量从一处送到另一处。

shots.scene: 手电光柱笔直地照向远处
shots.prompt_en: A flashlight beam shines in a perfectly straight line across a dark room. No people.
shots.narration: 光沿直线传播，和微波一样。

shots.scene: 地球图标外，一道光一眨眼绕了好几圈
shots.prompt_en: A beam of light circles a small globe icon several times in a blink. No people.
shots.narration: 约三亿米每秒，或约十八万六千英里每秒。

shots.scene: 光从空气进入水和玻璃，速度箭头变短
shots.prompt_en: A light beam passes from air into water and then glass, and its speed arrow gets shorter each time. No people.
shots.narration: 光速快慢，取决于它走过的介质。

shots.scene: 欣欣面前三个抽屉：尺子、闹钟、波浪计数器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands before three drawers labeled with icons: a ruler, an alarm clock, and a wave counter.
shots.narration: 光的量都很极端，得用合适单位。

shots.scene: 闹钟抽屉和计数器抽屉打开
shots.prompt_en: The alarm clock drawer and the wave counter drawer slide open, showing small tags. No people.
shots.narration: 时间用微秒纳秒，频率用兆赫到太赫。

shots.scene: 一排从大到小的套娃图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of nesting doll icons from very large to very small. No people.
shots.narration: 千、兆、吉、太往上，毫、微、纳、皮往下。

shots.scene: 两根橡皮筋交叉振动，一竖一横
shots.prompt_en: Two rubber bands vibrate crosswise, one up and down, the other side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 光波里振动的，是电场和磁场。

shots.scene: 电池图标连着竖向箭头，导线电流图标连着横向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon links to the vertical arrows, and a wire with flowing current links to the horizontal arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 电场连着电压，磁场连着电流。

shots.scene: 竖直方向黄色箭头、水平方向蓝色箭头，沿一条轴向前推进
shots.prompt_en: Yellow arrows vibrate in a vertical plane and blue arrows in a horizontal plane while both move forward along one axis. No people.
shots.narration: 电场、磁场、前进方向两两垂直。

shots.scene: 看台上一排排圆点依次起落，形成横向传播的人浪
shots.prompt_en: Rows of round dots in stadium seats pop up and down one after another, so a wave travels sideways across the stands. No people.
shots.narration: 振动方向和前进方向垂直，这是横波。

shots.scene: 一排大小不同的波，结构完全一样
shots.prompt_en: A row of waves of different lengths, all with the same crossed arrow structure. No people.
shots.narration: 所有电磁波结构一样，只差频率波长。

shots.scene: 一架长长的钢琴键盘，从低音到高音
shots.prompt_en: A very long piano keyboard stretches from low keys to high keys, each zone with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电磁波谱像一架很长的钢琴。

shots.scene: 低音区依次亮起电线杆、收音机、电视、雷达图标
shots.prompt_en: The low end of the keyboard lights up with icons: a power pole, a radio, a television, and a radar dish. No people.
shots.narration: 低频端：60赫兹电网、音频、广播电视。

shots.scene: 琴键上亮起雷达、卫星、无线信号图标
shots.prompt_en: Keys light up further along with icons of a radar dish, a satellite, and wireless signal waves. No people.
shots.narration: 再往上是微波：雷达和数据通信。

shots.scene: 中间一小段键亮起：红外、彩虹、紫外
shots.prompt_en: A short middle section of the keyboard glows: a warm red zone, a rainbow zone, and a violet zone. No people.
shots.narration: 中间是红外、可见、紫外，叫光学波段。

shots.scene: 高音区亮起X光片、原子、星空图标
shots.prompt_en: The high end of the keyboard lights up with icons: an X-ray film, an atom, and a starry sky. No people.
shots.narration: 再往上是X射线、伽马射线和宇宙射线。

shots.scene: 欣欣用放大镜对着中间那一小段
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass over the short middle section of the keyboard.
shots.narration: 光子学研究的，就是中间这一段。

shots.scene: 一条彩虹色带，从紫到红
shots.prompt_en: A rainbow color band running from violet on the left to red on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 可见光从紫到红，排成一条彩带。

shots.scene: 色带两端标出数字刻度
shots.prompt_en: Small tick marks appear at both ends of the rainbow band. No people.
shots.narration: 紫光约四百纳米，红光约七百纳米。

shots.scene: 一根头发丝旁边，挤满了密密的小光波
shots.prompt_en: Next to a single strand of hair, hundreds of tiny light waves are packed side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 光波极短，还有更小的单位叫埃。

shots.scene: 钢琴键盘上只有一小段被人眼图标照亮
shots.prompt_en: Only a tiny section of the long keyboard is lit by an eye icon looking at it. No people.
shots.narration: 人眼只能看见很窄的一段。

shots.scene: 那一小段两侧的长长琴键都是暗的
shots.prompt_en: The long stretches of keys on both sides of the lit section stay dark. No people.
shots.narration: 约4.3到7.5乘10的14次方赫兹。

shots.section_title: 折射率：光进介质会变慢
shots.scene: 跑道从柏油路进入沙地，跑步小人步子变小、速度变慢
shots.prompt_en: A running figure icon moves from a paved track onto sand; its steps get shorter and it slows down. No people.
shots.narration: 光进入水和玻璃，就像跑进了沙地。
overlay: 折射率：光进介质会变慢

shots.section_title: 折射率：光进介质会变慢
shots.scene: 空气中的长波进入玻璃块后波形变密
shots.prompt_en: A long wave in air enters a glass block and its crests become closer together. No people.
shots.narration: 速度变慢，波长也同样变短。

shots.section_title: 折射率：光进介质会变慢
shots.scene: 一把刻度尺对比空气和玻璃中的速度
shots.prompt_en: A simple gauge compares the speed arrow in air with a shorter speed arrow in glass. No people.
shots.narration: 折射率是真空光速除以介质光速。

shots.section_title: 折射率：光进介质会变慢
shots.scene: 空气中的波进入标着1.5的玻璃块，波长缩成三分之二
shots.prompt_en: A wave in air enters a glass block; its wavelength shrinks to two thirds while a speed arrow shortens. No people.
shots.narration: 折射率1.5，速度和波长都除以1.5。

shots.section_title: 折射率：光进介质会变慢
shots.scene: 真空标1，水、玻璃标更大的数
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes: empty vacuum, a water tank, and a glass block, each with a small number tag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 没有单位，真空是一，其他都大于一。

shots.scene: 跑步小人进沙地后，脚步节拍器的节奏没变
shots.prompt_en: The running figure enters the sand while a metronome next to it keeps exactly the same beat. No people.
shots.narration: 换了介质，节奏不变，频率不变。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着三个图标：速度变、波长变、频率不变
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three icons: a speed arrow that shrinks, a wave that tightens, and a metronome that stays the same.
shots.narration: 变的只有波长和速度。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现双面硬币和波浪图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the panda mascot float a two-sided coin icon and a wave icon.
shots.narration: 光是电磁能，既像波，又像粒子。

shots.scene: 尺子、时钟、跑道三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a ruler, a clock, and a racing track. No people.
shots.narration: 波长、周期、频率，连着光速。

shots.scene: 钢琴键盘中间一段发光
shots.prompt_en: The middle section of the long keyboard glows in rainbow colors. No people.
shots.narration: 光学波段是红外、可见和紫外。

shots.scene: 光进入玻璃块变密，节拍器不变
shots.prompt_en: A wave tightens as it enters a glass block while a metronome keeps the same beat. No people.
shots.narration: 进介质变慢变短，频率不变。

shots.scene: 欣欣在光学实验室门口挥手道别，身后彩虹光带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the optics lab door with a soft rainbow band of light behind it.
shots.narration: 第一课到这里，下一课讲光的波动。
